linux_rptr_crosscheck_20261024.interpretation: Linux and Android use the same VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack guest argument and translated host address. This verifies pointer routing only; the final stack snapshot does not establish that the guest advanced to visible gameplay, and retail pixels remain unverified.
